from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import stat
expected = {
    'a.html': '274c0c78ab873b426f5bd36395cb5b882eb2ed42e13d19a56621481affd6a817',
    'b.html': 'b14a646d4b996b848a293d9dfe7470b8082d64b1413c09c83b0a718f02daf195',
}
try:
    root = Path('/tmp/portal/local_pages')
    paths = list(root.rglob('*'))
    ok = all(not path.is_symlink() and (path.is_dir() or stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode)) for path in paths)
    actual = {str(path.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths if stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode)}
    ok = ok and actual == expected
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
